phase: Each of 3 operational layers receives 4 push events and 4 pull events; synchronized demonstration, not 24 payload bits.
unit: integer milliarcseconds; x is adjustable baseline; offset 1025 = 1.025 arcseconds
sign: push +x; pull -(x+1.025 arcseconds); net -4.100 arcseconds per layer per cycle
render: 3D perspective projected canvas; angular displacement exaggerated for visibility, not physical tornado simulation; Vogel is a user-defined composite and spiral rendering is a provisional interpretation
